job.job_description:
Job Summary

Build and scale the APIs, databases, and cloud infrastructure that power our clients AI-first products across web, SaaS, and enterprise platforms.

Responsibilities
Design, build, and maintain RESTful and GraphQL APIs using Node.js / Python
Architect scalable databases - PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis
Integrate third-party APIs (payment gateways, AI APIs, messaging platforms)
Write clean, tested, and well-documented code
Participate in code reviews and technical discussions
Collaborate with frontend developers and DevOps engineers
Requirements
2+ years of backend development experience
Proficiency in Node.js (Express / Fastify) or Python (FastAPI / Django)
Strong SQL knowledge - PostgreSQL preferred
Experience with REST API design and authentication (JWT, OAuth)
Familiarity with cloud services (AWS / GCP / Azure)
Git proficiency and understanding of CI/CD pipelines
Skills
Node.js
PostgreSQL
REST APIs
Docker
AWS/GCP


Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.
